fixture.title: Resend — reference components
fixture.description:
Reference fixture for design-systems/resend. Every visible
        value comes from tokens.css; the page itself follows Resend's
        rules — void-black canvas, near-white text, frost-blue borders
        instead of gray, one accent at a time (Resend Orange), ABC
        Favorit with -0.05em display tracking, Inter for body, Commit
        Mono for code.

selectors: /* Atmospheric warm gradient glow behind the hero — DESIGN.md §6 "Decorative Depth: subtle warm gradient glows behind hero content (orange/amber tints)". A radial wash of the accent at very low opacity

/* Eyebrow uses Commit Mono uppercase with positive tracking — the documented nav-link pattern from DESIGN.md §3: "ABC Favorit nav links use +0.35px letter-spacing — the only positive tracking in the system." We extend the same airy tracking to mono eyebrows so they read as a technical label rather than a heading. */ .eyebrow
/* ─── Badges ──────────────────────────────────────────────── * DESIGN.md §4 "Multi-color Accent Badges": background at * 12–42% opacity of the accent

/* ─── Buttons ─────────────────────────────────────────────── * DESIGN.md §4 documents three primary patterns: * .btn-pill transparent fill + frost border + pill radius * .btn-pill-white white solid fill + black label + pill radius * .btn-ghost transparent
/* ─── Cards ───────────────────────────────────────────────── * DESIGN.md §4: "Background: transparent or very subtle dark * tint. Border: 1px solid rgba(214
/* ─── Distinctive: Code preview panel ─────────────────────── * DESIGN.md §4 "Code Preview Panels": dark code blocks using * Commit Mono

/* ─── Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────── * DESIGN.md §4: "Radius: 4px. Focus: shadow-based ring." * Inputs use the frost-border via box-shadow so the focus * state can swap the shadow to the accent ring without a * layout shift. */ .field

/* ─── Links ───────────────────────────────────────────────── * Resend's link voice from DESIGN.md §2: link highlights are * the pure-white moment. We pair an underline that thickens * on hover with `--fg` (near-white) for body links — leaving * the orange accent for explicit CTA badges only

/* ─── Typography ──────────────────────────────────────────── * Three-font hierarchy: display uses ABC Favorit via the display * font token with aggressive negative tracking; body uses * Inter (var(--font-body)); code uses Commit Mono via the mono * font token. Hierarchy comes from size + tracking
0.19)." Radius * 16px (--radius-lg) for feature cards. Depth comes from the * frost border alone — no opaque blur shadow
blurred heavily — token-clean because it mixes var(--accent) over var(--bg) rather than introducing a raw hex. */ .hero::before
frost shadow-border edge. The mono face is * the "developer console voice" connecting marketing copy * to the product surface. */ kbd
not weight — * DESIGN.md §3 keeps weight at 400 / 500 / 600 only. */ h1
sharp 4px radius * The hero CTA pair below pairs a white-pill (max contrast) * with a frost-pill (subtle) — Resend's signature CTA shape. */ .btn
so the ≤2 * accent uses per screen rule holds even in copy-dense * sections. */ a

syntax-highlighted with multi- * color accent tokens. The 24px radius is the brand "Section" * radius (panel tier); reached inline because the schema's * --radius-lg caps at 16px and adding a fifth radius slot * would require a C-extension. */ .code-panel
text at full opacity. * `.badge-accent` uses the orange accent; `.badge-success` / * `.badge-danger` reach the semantic tokens. Pill radius * (9999px) is the brand-default badge shape. */ .badge
which would * vanish into the void. */ .card
